title: Resolve the generic two-by-four determinantal quotient

source.citation: Amelie Schreiber, Multiparameter Persistent Homology-Generic Structures and Quantum Computing, arXiv:2210.11433

translation.notes: Noether resolves the six printed minors after correcting the source ring from six to eight variables. It certifies the Eagon-Northcott totals (1,6,8,3), exposing that the paper's printed (1,6,8,4,1) format does not resolve this generic determinantal quotient. Integral and persistence exactification remain outside this case.
